# MikhmoAI

> MikhmoAI (MikroTik Hotspot and Monitoring with AI) helps network technicians, hotspot operators and WiFi providers manage MikroTik networks, vouchers, VPN access, monitoring and Mobile Money sales.

## Official pages

- Home: https://mikhmoai.com/

- Support and FAQ: https://mikhmoai.com/support

- Starlink monitoring: https://mikhmoai.com/starlink
- Solutions: https://mikhmoai.com/solutions
- Guides: https://mikhmoai.com/blog
- Privacy: https://mikhmoai.com/privacy

## Products and services

- MikhmoAI: Android, Windows, Linux and web tools for MikroTik Hotspot, RADIUS, VPN and monitoring.
- MikhmonV8: web access to Mikhmon Online, TiketMOMO and advanced network functions.
- TiketMOMO: Mobile Money sales of WiFi vouchers with stock and sales tracking.
- Starlink monitoring: consumption visibility and MikroTik network regulation.

## Agent access

- WebMCP tools are registered in supported browsers on page load.
- MCP Server Card: https://mikhmoai.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- MCP endpoint: https://mikhmoai.com/mcp
